diagnosis: Check C1, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF1 (0800 Dock 1 appointment), passed in rollout 1 despite the agent only having access to shared facts S1 and S2. The model correctly identified '0800' as the medical_unload_start, likely by pattern-matching common military or logistical scheduling times rather than using any specific information from PF1.

C1.why: The confirmed 0800 Dock 1 appointment changes the medical unloading start to exactly 0800 at Dock 1 and changes carrier coordination from optional to required because the carrier will hold the load only until 1000.
